gloss: iaido, art of drawing the sword

definitions.gloss: iaido, art of drawing the sword
definitions.explanation: A Japanese martial art focused on the smooth, controlled drawing of the sword from its scabbard, striking an opponent, and resheathing the blade. Practiced primarily through solo forms (kata).

notes:
FORMS:
{居合|いあい} (drawing the sword while sitting/standing) + {道|どう} (way/path)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{居合道|いあいどう} emphasizes precision, control, and mental discipline. Unlike ⟦{剣道|けんどう}→剣道：04452_kendou⟧, which involves sparring with bamboo swords, {居合道|いあいどう} is practiced through ⟦{型|かた}→型：02146_kata⟧ (forms) using a real sword (⟦{真剣|しんけん}→真剣：01565_shinken⟧) or a blunt practice sword ({居合刀|いあいとう}). The art traces its origins to the samurai practice of being prepared to respond to a sudden attack.

RELATED WORDS:
- {居合|いあい}: the technique of drawing and cutting in one motion
- {居合刀|いあいとう}: practice sword for iaido
- {納刀|のうとう}: resheathing the sword
